changeSet.comment: HealthAEye's nine acquisitions, in Visitenplan order.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO imaging_modality (study_id, code, label_de, label_en, device, kinds_accepted, laterality_required, auto_match_ae_title, ordinal, status_id, created_by_user_id) SELECT s.study_id, v.code, v.label_de, v.label_en, v.device, v.kinds, v.lat_required, v.ae_title, v.ordinal, 1, 1 FROM study s CROSS JOIN (VALUES -- 1. No file ever arrives for BCVA; it is a checklist row -- the data-entry path fills. kinds_accepted '' says so. ('BCVA', 'Visus (BCVA)', 'BCVA (letters + Snellen)', NULL, '', false, NULL, 1), ('OCT_SPECTRALIS', 'OCT 20×20°, 97 B-Scans', 'OCT 20x20deg, 97 B-scans', 'spectralis', 'e2e', true, NULL, 2), ('IR_SPECTRALIS', 'IR-Reflektanz 30×30°', 'NIR reflectance 30x30deg', 'spectralis', 'e2e,image', true, NULL, 3), ('RF_SPECTRALIS', 'Rotfrei 30×30°', 'Red-free 30x30deg', 'spectralis', 'e2e,image', true, NULL, 4), ('BAF_SPECTRALIS', 'Blau-Autofluoreszenz 30×30°', 'Blue autofluorescence 30x30deg', 'spectralis', 'e2e,image', true, NULL, 5), -- 6-7. Zeiss devices export files; there is no C-STORE. ('OCTA_PLEXELITE', 'OCTA 6×6 mm + 3×3 mm', 'OCTA 6x6mm + 3x3mm', 'plexelite', 'image,other',true, NULL, 6), ('FUNDUS_CLARUS', 'Fundusfoto zentral (Clarus)', 'Fundus photo, central (Clarus)', 'clarus', 'image', true, NULL, 7), ('FUNDUS_REMIDIO', 'Handheld-Fundus (Remidio)', 'Handheld fundus (Remidio InstaFOP)', 'remidio', 'image', true, NULL, 8), -- 9. The one device that identifies itself: its calling AE -- title classifies the image without an operator. ('FUNDUS_OPTOMED', 'Handheld-Fundus (Optomed)', 'Handheld fundus (Optomed Lumo)', 'OPTOMEDLUMO', 'dicom', true, 'OPTOMEDLUMO', 9) ) AS v(code, label_de, label_en, device, kinds, lat_required, ae_title, ordinal) WHERE s.oc_oid = 'S_HAE';

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM imaging_modality WHERE study_id IN (SELECT study_id FROM study WHERE oc_oid = 'S_HAE');

changeSet.comment: Performed boxes for the modalities whose CRF item is authored.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO imaging_modality_item_binding (imaging_modality_id, role, laterality, item_oid, performed_value, created_by_user_id) SELECT im.imaging_modality_id, 'performed', 'OU', v.item_oid, '1', 1 FROM imaging_modality im JOIN study s ON s.study_id = im.study_id JOIN (VALUES ('BCVA', 'I_HEALT_BCVA_PERFORMED'), ('OCT_SPECTRALIS', 'I_HEALT_OCT_PERFORMED'), ('FUNDUS_CLARUS', 'I_HEALT_CLARUS_PERFORMED'), ('FUNDUS_REMIDIO', 'I_HEALT_REMIDIO_PERFORMED'), ('FUNDUS_OPTOMED', 'I_HEALT_OPTOMED_PERFORMED') ) AS v(code, item_oid) ON v.code = im.code WHERE s.oc_oid = 'S_HAE' -- Guarded, not asserted: the CRF is authored in the app, and a -- binding to an absent item would warn on every single bind. AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item i WHERE i.oc_oid = v.item_oid);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM imaging_modality_item_binding WHERE imaging_modality_id IN ( SELECT im.imaging_modality_id FROM imaging_modality im JOIN study s ON s.study_id = im.study_id WHERE s.oc_oid = 'S_HAE');

changeSet.comment: Carry any custom ingest_performed_item_map rows into bindings.
changeSet.sql:
-- 1. A modality for any device the catalogue has never heard of. -- A map row applies to the study whose CRF actually contains -- its item; a global row (study_id NULL) can therefore land in -- more than one study, which is what it always meant. INSERT INTO imaging_modality (study_id, code, label_de, label_en, device, kinds_accepted, laterality_required, ordinal, status_id, created_by_user_id) SELECT DISTINCT a.study_id, upper(a.device_key), a.device_key, a.device_key, a.device_key, 'image,dicom', true, 99, 1, 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m.device_key, m.item_oid, s.study_id FROM ingest_performed_item_map m JOIN item i ON i.oc_oid = m.item_oid JOIN item_form_metadata ifm ON ifm.item_id = i.item_id JOIN crf_version cv ON cv.crf_version_id = ifm.crf_version_id JOIN event_definition_crf edc ON edc.crf_id = cv.crf_id JOIN study s ON s.study_id = edc.study_id WHERE m.study_id IS NULL OR m.study_id = s.study_id) a WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM imaging_modality_item_binding b JOIN imaging_modality im ON im.imaging_modality_id = b.imaging_modality_id WHERE im.study_id = a.study_id AND b.role = 'performed' AND b.item_oid = a.item_oid) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM imaging_modality im WHERE im.study_id = a.study_id AND lower(COALESCE(im.device, '')) = lower(a.device_key)) ON CONFLICT (study_id, code) DO NOTHING;
-- 2. The binding itself, now that every device has a modality. INSERT INTO imaging_modality_item_binding (imaging_modality_id, role, laterality, item_oid, performed_value, created_by_user_id) SELECT DISTINCT im.imaging_modality_id, 'performed', 'OU', a.item_oid, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.performed_value, ''), '1'), 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m.device_key, m.item_oid, m.performed_value, s.study_id FROM ingest_performed_item_map m JOIN item i ON i.oc_oid = m.item_oid JOIN item_form_metadata ifm ON ifm.item_id = i.item_id JOIN crf_version cv ON cv.crf_version_id = ifm.crf_version_id JOIN event_definition_crf edc ON edc.crf_id = cv.crf_id JOIN study s ON s.study_id = edc.study_id WHERE m.study_id IS NULL OR m.study_id = s.study_id) a JOIN imaging_modality im ON im.study_id = a.study_id AND lower(COALESCE(im.device, '')) = lower(a.device_key) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM imaging_modality_item_binding b JOIN imaging_modality im2 ON im2.imaging_modality_id = b.imaging_modality_id WHERE im2.study_id = a.study_id AND b.role = 'performed' AND b.item_oid = a.item_oid) ON CONFLICT (imaging_modality_id, role, laterality) DO NOTHING;
